name: Installation
tagline: Fitted right, so it cools right for years
summary: New AC installation and replacement, carefully fitted and ready for the season.
description: A good installation decides how well an AC performs for years. We survey the space, recommend the right capacity, and plan where the indoor and outdoor units go for airflow, drainage and easy servicing. Every job includes proper copper piping, vacuuming, leak testing and a final cooling check.
duration: 3 – 4 hours per split AC; larger systems by schedule
suitable_for: Split, window, cassette, tower, ductable and VRV/VRF systems
includes: Site survey and heat-load based capacity advice
Wall, ceiling, ductable and VRV/VRF installations
Copper piping, insulation, drain lines and stand fitting
Nitrogen pressure test, vacuuming and leak check
Commissioning with temperature and current readings
signs: You've bought a new AC and need it fitted
You're replacing an old or inefficient unit
You're fitting out a new home, office or shop
A previous installation keeps leaking or cooling poorly

options.name: Split AC installation
options.detail: Wall-mounted indoor unit, outdoor unit on bracket or stand

options.name: Window AC installation
options.detail: Window or wall opening with a support frame

options.name: Cassette / ceiling unit installation
options.detail: False-ceiling mounting with drain pump connection

options.name: Ductable / VRF installation
options.detail: Planned with ducting, piping and controls

process.title: Site survey
process.text: We check the room size, wall strength, outdoor unit location and power supply.

process.title: Fitting
process.text: Indoor and outdoor units are mounted, piped, insulated and wired.

process.title: Testing
process.text: Nitrogen pressure test, vacuuming and a leak check before gas is released.

process.title: Handover
process.text: We check cooling and current readings, then show you how to use and care for it.

faqs.question: Is extra copper piping charged?
faqs.answer: Standard installation includes a set pipe length. Longer runs are charged per metre, and we confirm this before starting.

faqs.question: Can you install an AC I bought online?
faqs.answer: Yes. We install all major brands, wherever you bought the unit.
